description: A React component implementing a carousel/slider with navigation controls, dots, and optional action button.

methods.name: nextSlide
methods.description: Advances the carousel to the next slide, updating button states and invoking callback if provided.

methods.name: prevSlide
methods.description: Moves the carousel to the previous slide, updating button states and invoking callback if provided.

methods.name: moveDot
methods.description: Sets the current slide to the specified index.
